_comment: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE - no real customer. Reference intake for sow_type=workspace_migration. Shows parallel tracks with phases, an effort schedule in hours, resource allocation, and a Google-funded deal where the customer pays a net amount - which makes the funding-reversal (clawback) paragraph mandatory.

customer.address: 18 Kingsway House, Leeds LS1 2ES, United Kingdom
customer.profile: Ardenmoor Group Ltd. is a professional services firm operating from four UK offices. It runs Microsoft 365 for mail and files, with an on-premises Active Directory providing endpoint authentication and single sign-on to a small set of line-of-business applications.

stakeholders.name: Tomas Reilly
stakeholders.title: Systems Administrator
stakeholders.description: User mapping, endpoint access and joint validation

background.objective:
Ardenmoor Group Ltd. is partnering with Premier Cloud Inc., a Google Cloud Premier Partner, to migrate from Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace and decommission its on-premises Active Directory.

The objective is an end-to-end migration of mail, files and endpoint identity for approximately 310 users within a 10-week window. Active Directory will be decommissioned and the SSO-integrated applications re-pointed to Google as the Identity Provider.

key_focus_areas.label: Mail & File Migration
key_focus_areas.text: Migration of mailboxes and OneDrive/SharePoint content in waves, with a delta sync at cutover

key_focus_areas.label: Endpoint Identity Migration
key_focus_areas.text: Active Directory decommission via Google Credential Provider for Windows, with user data preserved on-device

key_focus_areas.label: SSO Re-pointing
key_focus_areas.text: Re-configuration of the SSO-integrated applications to use Google as Identity Provider, validated per application

key_focus_areas.label: Cutover & Decommission
key_focus_areas.text: DNS changes, Gmail and Calendar activation, Active Directory decommission and operational handover

background.engagement_type: This is an execution engagement. Premier Cloud will perform the migration end-to-end, including discovery, configuration, pilot, wave migration, delta sync, cutover and post-migration validation.

decisions_pending: Ardenmoor IT completes the user mapping spreadsheet for all in-scope users and SharePoint sites by end of Week 1
Decisions on archive mailbox handling and external sharing strategy are finalised before the Week 2 pilot

phases.name: Phase 1: Preparation & Discovery (Week 1)
activities: Pre-migration scan of the source tenant covering mailbox count and size distribution, file volumes and externally-shared content
User mapping spreadsheet completed by Ardenmoor IT for all in-scope accounts and sites
Customer decisions documented for archive handling and external sharing strategy

phases.name: Phase 2: Configuration & Readiness Scan (Week 1)
activities: CloudM Migrate instance provisioned with 8 worker nodes
Domain mappings and per-entity migration batches configured
Readiness scan executed to validate connectivity and surface configuration issues prior to pilot

phases.name: Phase 3: Pilot Migration (Week 2)
activities: Pilot group of 20 users selected across departments and mailbox-size profiles
Pilot covers mail and OneDrive with full data fidelity validation
Pilot acceptance reviewed with Ardenmoor before proceeding to bulk waves

phases.name: Phase 4: Bulk Migration in Waves (Weeks 3-8)
phases.intro: Migration is sequenced by mailbox size, smallest first, to maximise early worker utilisation and contain risk:
activities: Wave 1 (Weeks 3-4): mailboxes under 1 GB
Wave 2 (Weeks 5-6): mailboxes 1-20 GB plus smaller SharePoint sites
Wave 3 (Weeks 7-8): mailboxes over 20 GB plus larger SharePoint sites

phases.name: Phase 5: Delta Migration & Cutover (Week 9)
activities: Final delta pass to capture new and changed mail and files
DNS cutover: MX, Autodiscover, SPF and DKIM records
Gmail and Google Calendar activated for all in-scope users

phases.name: Phase 6: Post-Migration Validation (Week 10)
activities: Reconciliation report reviewed for each migration batch
Spot-check audit of mailboxes and Drive folders against source counts
Outstanding remediation items tracked to closure

tracks.name: Track B - Endpoint Identity Migration (AD to Google Login)
tracks.description: Track B runs in parallel with Track A, in waves aligned to the data-migration waves.

phases.name: Phase 1: Endpoint Inventory & SSO Audit (Week 1)
activities: Inventory of all in-scope domain-joined Windows endpoints
Audit of the SSO-integrated applications currently authenticating via Active Directory
SSO re-pointing plan with per-application validation criteria

phases.name: Phase 2: Endpoint Pilot (Week 2)
activities: 10-device pilot validating profile migration, domain unjoin and GCPW installation
Active Directory kept live in parallel for two weeks post-pilot to enable rollback

phases.name: Phase 3: Endpoint Waves (Weeks 3-8)
activities: Endpoints migrated in three waves aligned to the data-migration schedule
VIP and executive endpoints scheduled in the final wave

phases.name: Phase 4: SSO Re-pointing & AD Decommission (Weeks 9-10)
activities: SSO applications re-pointed to Google as Identity Provider and validated against the Phase 1 test plan
Active Directory infrastructure decommissioned
Operational handover and decommission sign-off

scope.statement: This engagement is delivered in two parallel tracks over 10 weeks: Track A covers mail and file migration, Track B covers endpoint identity migration and Active Directory decommission.
out_of_scope_extra: Migration of Microsoft Teams content. Teams is being retained by Ardenmoor and is not in scope.
Migration of macOS endpoints. Ardenmoor's Mac fleet is managed separately and is out of scope for this phase.

assumptions: Intune remains operational throughout the migration window for pushing endpoint scripts and configuration profiles
Active Directory remains operational in parallel for the two weeks following the endpoint pilot to enable rollback

schedule.deliverable: Kickoff deck; Discovery Report; decision register
Configured migration project; readiness scan report
Endpoint inventory; SSO audit; re-pointing plan
SSO validation matrix; AD decommission checklist

resources.responsibilities: Project planning, weekly status, stakeholder coordination, sign-off
Migration tool configuration, batch execution, wave management and troubleshooting
Endpoint scripting, GCPW deployment, domain unjoin and SSO validation support

success_criteria: 100% of in-scope mailboxes migrated to Google Workspace with delta sync validated against the reconciliation report
100% of in-scope OneDrive and SharePoint content migrated to Google Drive and Shared Drives
100% of in-scope Windows endpoints transitioned to Google login with user data preserved
Active Directory decommissioned and all SSO-integrated applications re-pointed and validated
Mail flow cutover completed with no inbound mail loss
Final reports reviewed and validated by Ardenmoor stakeholders

line_items.label: Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace Migration, AD Decommission, SSO Re-pointing
